one_line: DeepSeek raises $15B, major model releases, and NVIDIA broadens AI tools.

themes.title: DeepSeek secures massive funding amid US restrictions
themes.text: DeepSeek raised roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after U.S. agencies were ordered to remove its technology.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: New large multimodal and agent models
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed the 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 multimodal model, released Voxtral 3 speech models and SDK, Anthropic launched Claude Duet agent, and OpenAI announced GPT‑6/6.1 availability on Google Cloud.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: NVIDIA expands AI infrastructure and models
themes.text: NVIDIA introduced the Minerva AIOps platform, integrated open‑weight models in European public‑sector projects, deployed Earth‑2 models for climate forecasting, cut inference costs for retailers, launched DSX for power‑bottleneck solutions, and added training tools to its Cosmos platform.

stories.headline: NVIDIA launches Minerva AIOps platform for AI factory observability
NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
NVIDIA DSX platform used to address power bottleneck in AI infrastructure
NVIDIA expands Cosmos platform with new training tools and data factory blueprints
